decision.explanation: The question asks when the Dallas County Courthouse was built. Multiple documents provide conflicting dates for the same building or different iterations of the courthouse. Document D1S1 states the courthouse was built in 1902, while D4S4 claims it was constructed in 1885, and D5S2 says it was completed on July 10, 1850. These discrepancies suggest either different structures or misattributed details. Since the question does not specify which iteration of the courthouse is being referenced, all three dates are retained as valid candidates based on their direct textual support.
